info.title: Tidefern API
info.description: Versioned REST contract for every Tidefern client. Health data travels only in request and response bodies, never in paths or query strings.

servers.description: Same origin as the web app

profile.description: The profile summary, or null until onboarding creates the profile

guardianOf.description: Children this actor is a guardian of

grants.description: Active grants where this actor is the grantee

action.description: What happened, as a neutral dotted name such as grant.revoke or export.create

category.description: The category touched, when the action has one

ExportHeader.description: The first line of an export file.

records.description: How many ExportRecord lines came before this one

ExportEnd.description: The last line of a complete export file. A file without it is incomplete and should be requested again.

kind.description: Which kind of row, such as profile, note or cycleEntry; never export or end, which name the first and last lines

ExportRecord.description: One row of the person's own data, with encrypted text decrypted and nothing from any other subject.

undoUntil.description: Until when the closure can be undone; null when the person chose delete now

deadlineAt.description: The 45 day clock every data request runs on

ClosureRequest.description: An account closure: every other session and every grant is revoked, the request is filed, and the deletion job runs when the undo window ends.

id.description: The closure request the first call filed

ClosureReplay.description: The answer to a close replayed with the same Idempotency-Key: the request's id only. Read GET /v1/me/close for its state.

CloseInput.description: The closure mode. Fresh authentication is required.

request.description: The open closure, or null when the account is not closing

CloseState.description: Whether the account is closing, and the request if so.

sessionsRestored.description: The sessions revoked at closure stay revoked; sign in again on other devices

grantsRestored.description: The grants revoked at closure stay revoked; share again from the sharing screen

CloseUndone.description: A closure cancelled inside its window. The request is cancelled and its deletion job removed; nothing revoked comes back.

post.summary: Invite someone into the actor's household
post.description: Mints a single-use token bound to the invitee's email, stores only its hash with a 72 hour expiry, and sends the link by mail. The actor's own household is created on the first invitation, unless she already belongs to a household she does not own (409 member_of_another_household). Needs a fresh authentication and an Idempotency-Key.
